g.title: TF_WFSTAGES
g.text: This field describes how stadium escalation will be handled through a rule selection.
This field shows the parameters useful to calculate the task due date.

With this flag ticked, users receiving a task in this stage can open a discussion with nominated users. These users will receive the task in read only mode and will be able to discuss until the task gets completed.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
